response.text: The reversal 2471 is a proper mirror of 2320. The 0.01 split on 2470 is a rounding artifact and not an error. I have enough to submit.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by h."JRNL_NO" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journal 1075 (invoice V0004-71228-46) is unbalanced: DR 6654.87 vs CR 6663.87 (9.00 difference).

findings.evidence_sql: select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on upper(trim(c."ACCT_CD"))=upper(trim(l."ACCT_CD")) where c."ACCT_CD" is null
findings.summary: Journal 1979 (invoice 589) posts a 1235.26 debit to account 5950, which does not exist in the chart of accounts (memo says it should be 5100 Office Supplies).

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT")
findings.summary: Journal 2470 (manual accrual by JSMITH) has POST_DT 20241116, after period 10 closed (CLOSE_DT 20241105) and outside the period's date range (20241001-20241031), yet it is assigned to closed period 10.

findings.evidence_sql: select "INV_ID","VEND_CD","INV_NO","INV_DT","INV_AMT","JRNL_NO" from "APINVH" where "INV_ID" in (select min("INV_ID") from "APINVH" group by upper(trim("VEND_CD")), regexp_replace(upper("INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') having count(*)>1) or "INV_ID" in (select max("INV_ID") from "APINVH" group by upper(trim("VEND_CD")), regexp_replace(upper("INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') having count(*)>1)
findings.summary: Invoice 801 duplicates invoice 249 (same vendor V0018, same invoice number V0018-47982-249 apart from a trailing space, same date and amount 14704.74). The duplicate has its own journal 2469, which duplicates journal 1409 and double-books the expense and the AP liability. Invoice 249 was paid, while 801 remains open.

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", sum(l."CR_AMT") gl_ap_credit from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' where i."INV_ID"=328 group by 1,2,3
findings.summary: Invoice 328 has INV_AMT 14357.03 but its journal 1544 records only 14339.03 to AP control 2000 (18.00 difference). The journal is internally balanced, so only a subledger-to-GL tie-out exposes it.

findings.evidence_sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Payment 95 for invoice 141 is 12409.93 but the invoice amount is 12409.94; the invoice is marked paid (P) despite a 0.01 short payment. The payment journal matches the payment amount, not the invoice.
